conditions: The currently listed location/cast batches have source-selected candidates, actual rendered evidence and recorded owner art/design acceptance where required.
Accepted pieces have been integrated through canonical sites, availability, authored choices and the existing C.19/save/receipt boundary, with peaceful alternatives preserved.

All 15 authored fights and the current tactical-policy gap have reproducible evidence; injuries, missing/arrested crew, rescue, bail, loot and fence/market/route income eligibility are verified rather than illustrated.
The finale design and eligible-income question are resolved, the 30% trip/trade rule is evaluated in actual full runs when integrated, and all current story beats/endings remain reachable.
A real complete chapter run, physical Pixel/iPad observations and matching tested-source/hub receipt have been reviewed; existing unresolved gates remain explicit.
After reviewing that evidence, the owner may commission a separate bounded proposal for additional content. These conditions describe what to review; satisfying them grants no automatic permission.
expansion.boundary: No new people, places, quests, chapter or engine migration is in this production sequence. New-content expansion requires a separate explicit owner/design direction after the listed work; this JSON and its UI contain no approval toggle or self-authorization.
